title: Implement OVER and XOVER command handlers
description:
Implement OVER [range|msgid]: return overview data for requested range or single message-ID. Implement XOVER [range]: legacy alias. Response format: tab-separated fields per RFC 3977. Artifact: reader/src/session/commands/over.rs.

Acceptance:
- OVER 1-10 returns 10 tab-separated overview lines (or fewer if range has gaps)
- OVER <msgid> returns single overview line
- XOVER produces identical output to OVER for same range
- Thunderbird's message list pane populates correctly using OVER responses
